notes: Inputs only; outcomes are never stored in the golden set. Edit policy: never edit a set in place — create a new version. Multi-set manifest; load_golden falls back to legacy single-set layout for old checkouts.

gsm8k_v1.notes: External arm: 50 GSM8K test-split items (openai/gsm8k, deterministic stride-20 slice), numeric-answer checks. Wrong answers fail unless the gold coincides with a number already in the question (echo collision) — treat as near-exact, not absolute. Regenerate with evals/tools/fetch_gsm8k.py.

v2.notes: Same 50 v1 queries (identical prompt_fingerprints) plus expect.checks: deterministic reference checks (numeric/contains/not_contains/sentence limits) authored per item. Checks table lives in evals/tools/build_v2.py.
